title: ESP32 GPS NTP Server
description: GPS disciplined ESP32 NTP server metrics from /metrics. Prometheus datasource required.

panels.title: Synchronization
panels.description: GPS lock or credible holdover; check Holdover separately.

panels.title: Clock offset (ns)
panels.description: Newest measured phase offset against GPS PPS.

panels.title: NTP requests / s
panels.description: Zero is expected until clients query the server.

panels.title: Clock offset (ns)
panels.description: Signed phase offset. Values are converted from seconds to nanoseconds.

panels.title: PPS jitter and fit residual (ns)
panels.description: The fit residual is not phase error. It includes oscillator frequency ramp; compare with predicted drift residual.

panels.title: Capture fit window samples
panels.description: Points in the current 240-second fit window. Fit validity is shown in the status row.

panels.title: PPS rejects and NMEA mispairs / hour
panels.description: Rolling one-hour increases; counter resets are handled by Prometheus.

panels.title: Signal strength by satellite (dB-Hz)
panels.description: Current C/N0. A lower bar may be a satellite near the horizon.

panels.title: Reply timing (µs)
panels.description: Reply-path measurements appear after NTP requests arrive.

panels.title: Reply-path spans (µs)
panels.description: EWMA software spans by stage. Select a series in the legend to focus on it.

panels.title: W5500 RX and ARP activity / s
W5500 version
panels.description: Healthy W5500 reads as 4; -1 means not applicable.

panels.title: Reset reason
panels.description: ESP-IDF esp_reset_reason_t values.

panels.title: Heartbeat / s
panels.description: A sustained drop to zero while the target is up suggests a stuck main loop.

panels.title: W5500 recoveries and management timeouts / hour
DHCP events / hour
panels.description: All zeros can be normal with a static address.

panels.title: TCXO error and learned residual (ppm)
panels.description: Series are hidden until the TCXO fit is valid.

panels.title: PPS versus TCXO (ns)
panels.description: Series are hidden until the TCXO fit is valid.

panels.title: Prometheus scrape
panels.description: Prometheus target health. This remains visible when the device metrics are missing.

panels.title: PPS edges / s
panels.description: Should be near 1/s during normal PPS reception.

panels.title: Satellite elevation (degrees)
panels.description: Elevation of each satellite in view; low elevation often means weaker signals.

panels.title: Satellites used in solution
panels.description: 1 means the satellite contributes to the navigation solution.

panels.title: Latitude (degrees)
panels.description: Coordinates are exposed by the device and visible to dashboard viewers.

panels.title: Capture clock offset (ns)
panels.description: PPS offset against the capture clock. Compare with clock offset.

panels.title: Fitted capture ticks per second
panels.description: Nominally about 80 million ticks/s; zero while the fit is unsolved.

panels.title: RTC offset (whole seconds)
panels.description: This RTC measurement has whole-second resolution; zero is not evidence of subsecond agreement.

panels.title: TCXO calibration samples
panels.description: Locked seconds incorporated into temperature compensation.

panels.title: PPS edge rate (detail)
panels.description: A missing or stalled PPS feed appears as zero while scraping continues.

panels.title: Reply span floor, EWMA, peak (µs)
panels.description: Selected stages only. Max and min are since boot; EWMA is current.

panels.title: DHCP lease (s)
panels.description: Zero may mean a static address.

panels.title: Interrupt to SEND distribution (p50/p95, µs)
panels.description: Estimated from cumulative bucket counters. Requires NTP requests; bucket resolution is coarse.
